thread:
marco: hey @people-ops :wave: I noticed my SSN still shows as "missing" in the payroll portal and my benefits page has the wrong plan code (showing HRA instead of HSA). I already submitted the docs during onboarding — who should I ping to get these synced before first payday? also I updated my federal withholding to married filing jointly on Day 1, but the preview payroll shows single. worried about tax withholdings for the first pay.

elaine (people-ops): hi marco, sorry about that — thanks for flagging. can you DM me the last 4 of your SSN and the filename you uploaded? we had a backlog of manual verifications last week so a few folks slipped through. for the benefits code: which provider shows HRA? (Workday/Benefits Portal?)

marco: DMed you the last4 and the upload name: marco_onboard_id.pdf. benefits portal is benefits.redwood.com (it shows "Plan code: RWD-HRA-STD-2026").

people-ops-bot: payroll-run:2026-03-20 18:00 UTC — payroll file exported to provider. Cutoff for changes to this cycle was 2026-03-20 15:00 UTC. Changes submitted after cutoff will apply to next pay period.

elaine (people-ops): thanks — looks like your docs arrived after the cutoff. good news: if we update your tax filing now, payroll team can apply a correction on the next cycle and process an off-cycle adjustment if needed. jasmine from payroll can confirm. for the HSA vs HRA mismatch i'll open a benefits sync ticket with our broker. can you run through these quick steps so we have everything in one place?

- confirm which bank account is on file for deposits (last 4): 6789
- paste the benefits portal screenshot here or upload to https://benefits.redwood.com/upload with filename marco_benefits_portal.png
- if you have a benefits enrollment confirmation email, forward that to benefits@redwood.com

jasmine (payroll): hey marco — thanks for the heads up. payroll team can do two things: update your federal withholding in the system (will affect next regular paycheck) and file a supplemental correction if the current cycle already paid you incorrectly. to proceed we need a completed W-4 change form (digital) — fill here: https://payroll.redwood.com/forms/w4-change (choose "marital status change"). once submitted, reply here and i'll queue the correction request.

jasmine (payroll): also, for the HSA: the benefits enrollment feeds into payroll using the broker's plan codes. if broker sends HRA code, payroll will deduct to HRA. elaine — if you can open ticket with broker and ask for immediate re-feed with plan RWD-HSA-2026, that'll fix deductions going forward. if the broker can backdate enrollment to the benefits effective date, payroll can retro-adjust contributions.

elaine (people-ops): opened ticket #BP-3921 with the broker and cc'd payroll. broker ETA 48-72 hrs. i've also escalated for priority since it's a first-pay issue.

marco: thanks. one last Q — is there a deadline to opt into 401k matching for this paycheck? I tried to enroll but the portal showed "pending".

jasmine (payroll): 401k enrollments that enter the payroll feed before cutoff are applied same cycle. if it's pending and missed the cutoff we'll pick it up next run. if you want retro match for the first pay, we can request an adjustment but that'll need HR approval — ping me after you finish the W-4 so I can bundle the requests.

marco: got it. Submitted W-4 change just now (form id: W4-214567). uploaded benefits screenshot as marco_benefits_portal.png. DMed SSN last4.

people-ops-bot: ticket BP-3921 updated: broker acknowledged, will re-feed plan codes. ETA 2026-03-22 12:00 UTC.

jasmine (payroll): perfect. i've queued the change and added a correction request if needed. i'll update here once payroll posts the next run or processes an off-cycle adjustment.

elaine (people-ops): thanks marco — follow-up: if you don't see the deduction change by your next pay (2026-03-31), ping us and we'll request an off-cycle. welcome aboard and sorry for the signup hiccup! :tada:

marco: appreciate the quick help, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
